node.label: Reduced phytanic acid oxidase activity in cultured fibroblasts
node.definition: Activity of the enzyme phytanoyl-CoA hydroxylase (PhyH; EC 1.14.11.18) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts. PhyH plays a role in the catabolism of phytanic acid, a branched-chain fatty acid that is a normal constituent of the human diet.

evidence.snippet: Refsum disease: Reduced phytanic acid oxidase activity in cultured fibroblasts (frequency 20/20) [PCS]
